signal_estimate.consistency_note: windows are built from the through (and protected-left) crossings, so those shares are near 100% by construction; right turns and permissive lefts are the informative rows

representative_cycle.rule: qualifying cut (every head green, none unknown, closes legally) whose head greens and length are nearest their medians (summed |difference|); earliest on a tie

baseline.valid_means: run validity: no teleports or collisions, every vehicle arrived; not model validity

notes: simulated: window [warm-up, warm-up + horizon) of each seed; observed: the 900 s trajectory window
throughput is demand-derived: demand is generated at the observed counts, so its agreement shows the demand was served, not that the signal model is right

simulated queue: SUMO queueing_length of the longest approach lane per step, from SUMO's stop line; observed queue: counting gate to the front of the last queued vehicle (one vehicle length shorter), within the observed lane length
an observed value marked lower_bound includes seconds when the queue reached the end of the observed lane (censored)
cross-street queues are not observable: those arms are tracked only from about their limit lines
delay is not observed here; no observed counterpart is given
